lessons.problem: The initial new regression suite failed during fixture setup when Windows Git read GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL set to the Node os.devNull device-namespace path.
lessons.failed_attempt: Use the Node portable null-device constant without checking compatibility of the Git subprocess.
lessons.verified_root_cause: The actual Git build rejected that device-namespace path as an invalid global-config file.
lessons.correction: Use NUL for Git global-config isolation on Windows and os.devNull elsewhere. Keep global/system config isolation; do not disable the guard to make tests pass.
lessons.outcome: New offline fixtures23/23 passed; the combined41/41 suite subsequently passed on exact published head.
lessons.applies_when: A Node tool passes null-device paths to Git on Windows; validate actual subprocess behavior.
lessons.limitations: Linux compatibility is covered by source branch logic, not a Linux execution performed in this session. No universal Windows Git compatibility claim.
